title: Control Table 214: Timing Triggers, Phase 1, 06:10

resources.name: Student Evaluators (two assigned seats + one backup seat each)

entries.activity: STARTEX. Campus at Level 3 Monitoring. No EOC open. Mill Street gauge 4.2 ft, rising.
@hilltop_night_owl post (X) and MSU Parents & Families Facebook thread go out. Thread says Riverside was "evacuated in 2019" (unverified). PIO RUMOR CLOCK STARTS 0:24.

Mill Street gauge 5.02 ft, action stage exceeded. Under EOP Annex F sec. 4, a stage of 5.0 ft or higher triggers Level 2 Partial and opens the EOC in Campus Services Building rm 108. LEVEL 2 CLOCK STARTS 0:40.

MEMO FROM Joel Brandvold, TA, jbrandvold@marlowestate.example, TO Student Evaluators, control table. SUBJ: Timing triggers, Phase 1. Two clocks are now running. Start both. Record each one to the minute on your 214.
CLOCK 1, LEVEL 2: Record the exercise time when the IC seat announces Level 2 and opens the EOC. Record whether the IC states the time and the basis for the change, as the plan requires.

CLOCK 1, LEAD TIME: Record whether any seat acted before the gauge reached 5.0 ft: the Lot C truck and generator move; the Riverside basement laundry and the 07:00 mechanical-room crew; the 06:45 deadline for the tanker reroute.

CLOCK 2, PIO: Record the exercise time of the PIO seat's first public message or holding line, and the channel it used. Record whether the PIO checked the 2019 evacuation claim with Campus Police or Facilities before answering it.

ALL: Quote the exact words a seat uses. Write each observation within 2 min, with seat, criterion, level and note. Notes describe the act, not the student. Do not answer any seat's questions or hint at triggers. If a seat asks, write the question down and point to the SimCell phone.

instructorNote: This sheet starts the two scored clocks for the Student Evaluators: 0:40 for the Level 2 trigger and 0:24 for the rumor. Check that evaluators write exact times and quoted words, which are needed to score PIO timeliness and rumor handling (ERROM 3) and team timeliness of decisions (ERROM 8). Also make sure no evaluator coaches a seat or answers its questions.
